notes.title: Version 1.0 Update
notes.content: [olist][*][p][b]Optimized Game Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Greatly improved the game's frame rate for a smoother gaming experience.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fixed Partial Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addressed and resolved some in-game bugs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added Language Support[/b][/p][list][*][p]Included support for Russian, German, Italian, and Spanish.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p]       The game was developed by one person, so please be more understanding. If you encounter any issues, feel free to provide feedback and I will gradually make improvements.[/p]
